text:
kai: Starting preflight for rollout of llm-route v2 -> v2.1. Plan: enable ff llm_route_v2=true for 5% -> 20% over 30m. Quiet window tonight 23:00-02:00. Need ops ACK and decide on sticky pin for session-affinity. Ping @sasha @anya

sasha: Ack from infra. Observability hooks ready (canary dashboards + latency heatmap). Can we add a short-circuit to auto-drift back to v1 on error budget breach?

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: rollout/llm-route-v2 job_id=roll-34321. Scheduled start 2025-01-08T23:10:00Z. Canary region: us-west-2

anya: Suggest sticky pin for new sessions only (session_affinity=sticky_new). Rollback triggers: latency > 200ms OR error_rate > 1% sustained for 5m -> immediate pause + manual rollback. Quick unpin endpoint: POST /internal/flags/llm_route_v2/actions

kai: Copy. Ramp schedule I plan: 5% @t0, 10% @t+10m, 20% @t+30m. Manual pause at each step for telemetry check. I'll attach release notes and include note about session stickiness.

ops-bot: Alert rule added: metric llm_route_v2_errors_pct > 1 over 5m -> notify #incidents + trigger 'feature-pinback' workflow to pin to v1.9

sasha: Confirming pin command; here's the ops play snippet:

```bash
curl -X POST "https://internal.redwood/api/flags/llm_route_v2/actions" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_API_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"action":"pin","version":"v1.9","scope":"global"}'
```

anya: I'll watch canaries and run manual smoke checks (latency p50/p95, token throughput, sample outputs). If we abort: deploy-bot abort roll-34321 + drain new sessions, then pin v1.9.

kai: Thanks — unless objections, we start at 23:10. Will post brief notes to #release-notes and tag SRE. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
